criterion: A headline is correct if it reports the same event as its story, or a direct development of that event (reactions, follow-ups, aftermath). Previews before the event, other events involving the same person, and unrelated stories sharing generic words are wrong.

sets.name: Tuning set
sets.sample: 60 stories drawn at random (seed 2026) from all 221 stories of 22–29 Oct 2026

sets.name: Validation set
sets.sample: 40 unseen stories (seed 777) built with PRUNE .3 / ORIGIN_MIN .35, sharing no headline with the tuning set

note: The confidence threshold (coherence ≥ 0.4) was chosen using both sets, so these figures are in-sample; a fresh audit on new data is scheduled to confirm them.
